resources.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

decomposition: F(observer at release) - F(truth at release) after common learned free propagation; then F(truth at release propagated by the learned law) - F(truth at reload); then F(truth at reload) - measured cell force. Force evaluations share the learned contact solve, actual next sole height and area. Signed components sum per event. Their absolute errors need not sum.
scope: Diagnostics on development episodes using independent plant states offline.
